justification: Alarm logic (two new red keys) and the monitor launcher. No DB writes, no user-facing text.

falsifiable_check.command: PYTEST_REAL_DB=1 python -m pytest -o addopts= tests/test_verifyops_deploy_check.py tests/test_verifyops_coverage_real_db.py tests/test_verifyops_daily_check.py
falsifiable_check.fails_when: a killed full run, a NULL/unknown sha, or an image file changed after the deployed sha is not red; or a merge touching no image file is red
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Before the fix the live coverage had no key for run 1 (finished_at NULL since 2026-10-22 20:23 UTC). Real-DB test inserts that row shape -> run_unfinished red; real commits 732ef41b vs 2caecd2e -> deployed_not_main red. Each of 10 mutants made at least one test fail.

break_it.scenario: Railway deploys a new image while a cron run is in progress (run 1, 2026-10-22)
break_it.how: run row keeps finished_at NULL; run_unfinished goes red after 6 h
break_it.what_happens: silent: no red key / no log

break_it.scenario: Coverage runs in a shallow clone that lacks the deployed sha
break_it.how: git diff exits 128 -> deployed_not_main red (cannot prove), never green
break_it.what_happens: silent: no red key / no log

break_it.scenario: A merge changes only frontend files
break_it.how: Railway skips the deploy; no image file differs; key stays green (real commits 2caecd2e->54abc444)
break_it.what_happens: silent: no red key / no log

break_it.scenario: A run is killed mid-way by a deploy and leaves no log
break_it.how: stdout now streams unbuffered, so the log shows how far it got
break_it.what_happens: silent: no red key / no log
break_it.repro: railway logs -s dcp-monitor -d <removed deployment id>  (before: only Starting/Stopping Container)

mutation_analysis: 14 hand mutants, 14 killed: the 10 first-round ones, plus 4 after the Sol review (40-hex sha guard, --chown flag skip, multi-source COPY, COPY --from skip). Sol #1/#2 accepted and fixed; #3-#7 rejected (env is always os.environ; a missing Dockerfile already exits 2; streaming stdout is intended).
residual_risk: deployed_not_main compares the latest full run, which is up to a day old; a deploy between runs is not seen until the next run records its sha. The Actions checkout must have history for the sha (otherwise red, which is loud not silent).

post_merge.manual_verify: Set DCP_MONITOR_FORCE=1 on dcp-monitor, run once, unset; confirm a force row with finished_at and git_sha = merge commit.

pre_impl.existing_data: Reuses dcp_monitor_runs.git_sha (written by verifyops_record from RAILWAY_GIT_COMMIT_SHA) and Dockerfile.monitors' own COPY list; no new table, no migration.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Spec said compare git_sha with the main merge commit. Measured: Railway SKIPS merges that touch no image file (54abc444), so HEAD comparison would be red after every unrelated merge. Compared the image's files instead.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Two entries added to the existing QUERIES/measure() in verifyops_coverage; one helper added to run_monitors. No parallel alarm.

functions.name: deployed_not_main
functions.input: deployed sha (may be None), image paths, main ref
functions.output: bool: True means the deployed image cannot be proven current (red)
functions.if_none: None/empty sha or no paths -> True (red); git exit 128 (unknown sha) -> True

functions.name: image_paths
functions.input: the full text of Dockerfile.monitors as a string
functions.output: sorted COPY source paths, excluding COPY --from

functions.name: deploy_keys
functions.input: an open psycopg2 connection to the production database
functions.output: a list holding the fleet key '*|*|deployed_not_main', or an empty list

functions.name: monitor_cmd
functions.output: cmd, with --force only for dcp-monitor when DCP_MONITOR_FORCE is exactly 1
functions.if_none: DCP_MONITOR_FORCE unset or any other value returns the command unchanged
